name: MyDCD Berhad
recent: MyDCD Berhad 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发售价为每股 RM0.56，首日开盘价低于发售价。上市后不久，公司公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。多名董事及大股东在上市前后申报了股权变动。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 17 日在 Bursa Malaysia 的 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发售价为每股 RM0.56。
公司公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。
多名董事在 2026 年 11 月 12 日以每股 RM0.56 认购了 IPO 股份。
risks: 公司上市首日开盘价低于 IPO 发售价。
有多名大股东申报股权变动，包括部分人士不再是大股东。

recent_en: MyDCD Berhad listed on the ACE Market on 17 November 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.56 per share, with its opening price below the offer price. Shortly after listing, the company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. Several directors and substantial shareholders reported changes in their interests around the listing.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 17 November 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.56 per share.
The company announced its quarterly results for the financial period ended 30 September 2026.
Several directors subscribed for IPO shares at RM0.56 per share on 12 November 2026.
risks_en: The company's opening price on its first trading day was below the IPO offer price.
Several substantial shareholders reported changes in their interests, including persons ceasing to be substantial shareholders.
